question: On the same held-cell endpoint and held-biological-unit split, how much do discrete identity, continuous genes, and identity+genes predict?
outer_split: LeaveOneGroupOut over biological unit for all included datasets
type_vocabulary: fit on outer-training biological units only; unseen held-out identity encoded as all-zero one-hot
gene_preprocessing: training-fold median imputation + variance filter + StandardScaler
alpha_selection: inner LeaveOneGroupOut over outer-training biological units; Ridge alpha grid 1e-2..1e4
extremes: held-cell labels defined using outer-training 1/3 and 2/3 phenotype quantiles
inference: macro mean across held biological units; candidate-vs-identity exact sign-flip preserves held-unit effect magnitudes
guardrail: C. elegans excluded from continuous-molecular main comparison because expression is a repeated neuron-class lookup; use identity-held stress test instead.
